record.source_text: (7) Pursuant to paragraphs 1 to 5, the following shall also be treated as such — allowances and supplementary payments included in the remuneration continued to be paid to released members of the works council, — similar allowances and supplementary payments to staff representatives within the meaning of the Federal Staff Representation Act (Bundes-Personalvertretungsgesetz) and similar state legislation, — allowances and supplementary payments included in wages continued to be paid to the employee in the event of illness.
